# `network/chunks/ChunkFragmenter.js`

> **Source:** `engine/network/chunks/ChunkFragmenter.js`

network/chunks/ChunkFragmenter.js — split large objects into chunks, and chunks into transport-sized fragments (network plan §27/§31/§32).

## Functions

### `splitIntoChunks(bytes, chunkSize = DEFAULT_CHUNK_BYTES)`

Split an object's bytes into chunks no larger than `chunkSize` (which must not exceed the network-wide 4MB ceiling).

**Parameters:**

- `bytes` *(Uint8Array)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `[chunkSize]` *(number)* — _No description in source JSDoc._

### `splitChunkIntoFragments(chunkBytes, fragmentSize = DEFAULT_FRAGMENT_BYTES)`

Split one chunk's bytes into transport-sized fragments.

**Parameters:**

- `chunkBytes` *(Uint8Array)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `[fragmentSize]` *(number)* — _No description in source JSDoc._

### `reassembleFragments(fragments)`

Concatenate fragments back into one chunk's bytes.

### `reassembleChunks(chunks)`

Concatenate chunks back into the full object's bytes.
